_comment: App Toolkit collects NO data. All loan tracking, EMI calculation, bill reminders, and amortization scheduling run fully on-device. No account, no analytics, no telemetry, no third-party trackers. Interest Rates (FRED), Country Macro Data (World Bank), and Currency Exchange Rates make read-only public-data requests that carry no personal identifiers. Your data stays on your device and is never transmitted to Your Organization Name or any third party.
